rows.note: This is the all-purpose everyday choice for a small visible dot or for the dot said aloud in a web or email address.

example.english: There's a dot of ink on the paper.
example.jyutping: zoeng1 zi2 soeng6 jau5 jat1 dim2 mak6 seoi2

rows.note: Use this specifically for a sentence-ending full stop or period, not for a dot in an address.

example.english: Put a dot at the end of this sentence.
example.jyutping: ni1 geoi3 zeoi3 hau6 jiu3 gaa1 geoi3 hou6

rows.note: Use this specifically for the decimal point in a number.

example.english: You can't leave out the dot in three point one four.
example.traditional: 三點一四入面個小數點唔可以漏。
example.jyutping: saam1 dim2 jat1 sei3 jap6 min6 go3 siu2 sou3 dim2 m4 ho2 ji5 lau6

rows.note: Use this for a tiny amount or something extremely small, rather than a literal round mark.

example.english: I only want a dot of cream on top.
example.traditional: 上面加一丁點忌廉就得喇。
example.jyutping: soeng6 min6 gaa1 jat1 ding1 dim2 gei6 lim4 zau6 dak1 laa3
